name: ARROW / TRADE-OFF PRINCIPLE
scope: AFAH -> CEREBRON ΑΩ -> colonies -> agents -> tools
scientific_note: Engineering principle inspired by social-choice trade-offs; not a claim that Arrow's theorem directly proves an AI architecture result.
rule: NO PERFECT SYSTEM -> EXPLICIT TRADE-OFFS -> MISSION-DEPENDENT OPTIMUM
requirements: Declare mission objectives and non-negotiable constraints before arbitration.
When objectives conflict, record what is preserved, what is sacrificed, and why.
Do not treat majority, consensus, or agent count as truth.
Preserve provenance, uncertainty, canonical tool results, evidence status, and auditability.
Use mission-dependent weighting or Pareto-style selection rather than a universal winner.
Retain minority blockers and contradictory evidence for Red Team review.
